$comment: Committed sha256 digest table of the Claude Code binaries in the tested window (K8, ADR-0011, plan 1.8): version, then platform (<process.platform>-<process.arch>), then the sha256 and size of the native binary. Values from tooling/cli-pin.json (npm integrity and manifest.json cross-checked, research 05 section 1). Changed only by the version-bump PR the lead prepares locally (K16); provenance.ts mirrors it and a test keeps both equal to the pin. darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64 are left out on purpose until the macOS gate (M1) has recorded and cross-checked their digests; until then a darwin binary is unverified in advisory mode and refused in strict mode unless the application supplies claudeCode.binaryDigests.
